==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* He was the first player to hit Challenger tier in the Philippines
* He was the number 1 solo queue rank player during Season 2
* Yume tends to change his name a lot, copying pros from the LoL and DotA scene because he claims that he looks up to them as his inspiration.
